answer: Cluster-deflated voting resists sybils: fingerprint each identity's writing style, and any group of accounts that statistically reads as one author splits a single voice N ways — clones may whisper in unison but carry one vote. That collapses the farming horizon to zero payoff while honest identities keep full weight. To escape, an attacker must fund genuinely distinct authorship per identity — labor-intensive, ivory-grade work that scales linearly with every fake, outpricing any reward it chases.
